subject: pharmacology
title: Pituitary drugs: GH, desmopressin, oxytocin and dopaminergics

steps.tx: **Growth hormone** treatment replaces documented deficiency that stimulation testing confirms in short children. Somatropin acts through **IGF 1** and it increases growth velocity when deficiency truly limits stature. Turner syndrome, chronic kidney disease and small for gestational age status also qualify selected children for treatment. Excess hormone causes acromegaly, which surgery, somatostatin analogues and receptor blockade treat in adults. Treatment watches for raised intracranial pressure, slipped capital femoral epiphysis and glucose intolerance during follow up.
steps.say: Growth hormone treatment replaces documented deficiency that stimulation testing confirms in short children evaluated carefully. The hormone acts through a growth factor mediator and it increases velocity when deficiency limits stature. Turner syndrome and chronic kidney disease also qualify selected children for treatment in specialist clinics today. Excess hormone causes acromegaly in adults and treatment removes or blocks that excess effectively there. Clinicians watch for raised intracranial pressure and slipped epiphysis during follow up of treated children.

steps.tx: **Desmopressin** selectively activates V2 receptors and it avoids the pressor effect of native vasopressin. It treats **central diabetes insipidus**, where thirsty patients pass large volumes of dilute urine daily. A supervised challenge that concentrates urine on the drug separates central disease from nephrogenic resistance clearly. The drug also helps nocturnal enuresis and mild haemophilia by releasing stored clotting factor from endothelium. Excess dosing causes hyponatraemia, so fluid restriction and sodium checks protect treated patients carefully.
steps.say: Desmopressin selectively activates renal receptors and it avoids the pressor effect of native vasopressin in patients. It treats central diabetes insipidus where thirsty patients pass large volumes of dilute urine daily at home. A supervised challenge concentrates urine and it separates central disease from nephrogenic resistance very clearly indeed. The drug also helps nocturnal enuresis and mild haemophilia in selected patients needing treatment occasionally. Excess dosing causes hyponatraemia so fluid restriction and sodium checks protect treated patients carefully always.

steps.tx: **Oxytocin** induces and augments labour and it prevents and treats postpartum haemorrhage in obstetrics. Titration follows contraction monitoring because **hyperstimulation** distresses the fetus and forces the team to stop the infusion. Ergometrine sustains uterine tetany but hypertension forbids its use in pre eclamptic mothers after delivery. Carboprost rescues atonic bleeding although asthma forbids it because bronchospasm can follow quickly afterwards. Active management of the third stage prevents most postpartum haemorrhage in modern practice worldwide.
steps.say: Oxytocin induces and augments labour and it prevents postpartum haemorrhage in obstetric practice every day worldwide. Titration follows contraction monitoring because hyperstimulation distresses the fetus and forces infusion stopping immediately afterwards safely. Ergometrine sustains uterine contraction but hypertension forbids its use in pre eclamptic mothers after delivery occurs. Carboprost rescues atonic bleeding although asthma forbids it because bronchospasm can follow quickly after injection. Active management of the third stage prevents most postpartum haemorrhage in modern practice today overall.

steps.tx: **Dopamine agonists** such as cabergoline shrink prolactin secreting pituitary tumours and restore fertility in patients. High dose treatment for Parkinson disease risks **valvulopathy**, so echocardiography watches patients on large cumulative doses. These drugs can also trigger impulse control disorders that families often report before patients do. Nifedipine leads tocolysis for preterm labour and buys time for antenatal steroids to mature fetal lungs. Magnesium protects the fetal brain, while lost reflexes warn of maternal toxicity needing calcium.
steps.say: Dopamine agonists such as cabergoline shrink prolactin secreting pituitary tumours and restore fertility in patients treated. High dose treatment risks valve disease so echocardiography watches patients on large cumulative doses over time. These drugs can trigger impulse control disorders that families often report before patients recognise them themselves. Nifedipine leads tocolysis for preterm labour and buys time for steroids to mature fetal lungs. Magnesium protects the fetal brain while lost reflexes warn of maternal toxicity needing calcium rescue.

steps.tx: This coronal magnetic resonance image shows a large sellar **adenoma** expanding upward from the pituitary fossa. The mass stretches the **pituitary stalk** sideways and presses directly against the optic chiasm above. That chiasmal pressure explains bitemporal visual field loss, which examiners pair with galactorrhoea or acromegaly features. A prolactin secreting tumour in this picture shrinks on cabergoline, while non functioning tumours usually need surgery. Reading the anatomy first tells you which hormone story the stem expects.
steps.say: This coronal image shows a large sellar tumour expanding upward from the pituitary fossa in the midline. The mass is seen stretching the pituitary stalk sideways and pressing directly against the optic chiasm above. That chiasmal pressure explains bitemporal visual field loss which examiners pair with hormone excess features often. A prolactin secreting tumour shrinks on medical treatment while non functioning tumours usually need surgery performed. Reading the anatomy first tells you which hormone story the examination stem expects next time.
